summary: Load DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash MXFP4-CSF checkpoints at TP3
compatibility: No user action required. TP1, TP2, TP4 and TP8 are unchanged; DeepSeek-V4-Flash and Kimi-K3 keep their existing TP sizes.
details: The deepseek_v41 MXFP4-CSF reader admits --tensor-parallel-size 3. Each rank owns 768 of the 2304 routed-expert channels, which keeps the 32-channel and 16-row scale-slab alignment the slicer requires.
The checkpoint keeps its source config; the existing TP3 attention head padding applies at runtime.
